question: Reviewer R2.2: how far does a first-step input velocity reset depart from the natural trajectory, and does this response persist across the fixed test cohort?
authorization: Existing user authorization for reviewer-focused frozen five-seed small studies and autonomous execution; no new training or formal50 run.
source_route_decision: Prefer the pre-existing same-format SkillCorner test cohort to avoid introducing GSR resampling and team/ball assumptions. This route decision uses split/schema evidence only, not response or test performance. Nine SoccerTrack fixtures remain a separate exposed-domain input-support audit.

cohort.selection: All source test_indices, in original source order, without replacement or outcome/response selection. Actual cache uses non-overlapping 30-frame windows, despite earlier split metadata specifying stride10.
cohort.scope: Existing retrospective provider-detected cache cohort; its original admission uses any valid history/future support and the 30-frame identity union. Not a newly blind prospective prefix-sampled population. Positive exposure evidence: old reserved_test_confirmation_v1 completed scores on256 windows/20 old model cells on2026-10-23; its status records test_metrics_viewed=true. This is a subsequent frozen response diagnostic on source-test held-out matches, not a fresh blind test.

models.checkpoint: All five fixed epoch4 / 96-update final checkpoints already frozen in full_intervention/assets.json, whose SHA is bound at implementation freeze. No best checkpoint or seed selection.
models.analytic: One deterministic CV on exactly the same prefixes and commands; not replicated as five independent seeds.
models.numerics: Original CPU FP32 deterministic MATH SDPA, one torch thread, TF32 off; original model/api/operator mathematics unchanged.

input.coordinate_scope: Provider physical coordinates scaled to nominal105x68 metre-equivalent coordinates, not newly certified physical measurement accuracy.
input.prefix: Only original first10 states/valid flags enter model and actor selection. Extract separately from future target arrays; retain original missingness.
input.identity: Source roster home/away verification and original explicit semantic ball_data key. No invented player IDs, attack roles, possession, or ball observations. Inactive padding stays masked.
input.targets: Original rule: first two lexical source-ID-sorted home/team0 players with t0 full-state validity. Actor A is the diagnostic target; fewer than two remains UNSUPPORTED. No future-support actor selection.
input.commands: Original absolute command v0+delta; delta is 0.1*(-vy,vx)/norm(v0) when speed>=0.1, otherwise (0.1,0). Compute once from the natural prefix for all paths and seeds.
input.source_implementation_check: Before forward, audit the original velocity-slot mapping when home roster count<11. If valid input is affected, retain affected cohort rows as technical unsupported pending a separately versioned correction; never silently repair the old cache or model.

paths.name: first_provenance_only_A
paths.semantics: bypass with explicit first provenance-only control
paths.control: Keep history values and usable mask byte-identical; clear only actor A terminal observation flag and recompute observation age with the original function before rollout. Not a no-op and not a measured intervention.

limits.interpretation: Original engineering request bounds, not validated physiological limits. Rejected requests stop that branch; retain rejection reason/step and NA, do not clip or substitute outputs.

endpoints.primary: Actor A displacement vector and distance between first_A and natural at all20 steps; predeclared emphasis0.2,1,2s and d(2)-d(0.2). Per-window distributions and per-match summaries; no near-zero denominator retention ratio.
endpoints.mechanism_controls: Report first_A minus first_provenance_only_A and provenance-only minus natural. Vector differences decompose; distance norms do not. Persistent_A versus natural and maintained_v0_A is separate from first-step semantics.
endpoints.direction: Signed projection onto the fixed delta direction, to expose sign reversal hidden by distance.
endpoints.joint_response: Other historically usable players' RMS displacement relative to the same model natural path; exclude ball from player summaries.
endpoints.secondary_factual_forecast: Natural player ADE over20 future steps and FDE at1/2s, paired D/CV on common historical support and independently recovered provider-detected position truth. Truth loaded only by scoring stage after prediction outputs are frozen. If raw truth reconstruction cannot be verified, do not substitute zeroed invalid state positions.
endpoints.technical_checks: NONE bitwise equal natural; first_provenance_only keeps values unchanged; CV direct-versus-iterated tolerance1e-4; CV response equals t*delta within1e-4 and first/persistent agree on completed support; original immutable/locality/no-support-creation checks; D native versus adapter baseline tolerance1e-6.

denominators: Retain all4992 planned rows and all4 matches. Separately report source identity/history eligibility, actor eligibility, request acceptance, each path completion/rejection, truth support and common paired support. Each contrast uses its own pairwise support: first-versus-natural never requires persistent success. Cross-model common support is used only for D-versus-CV paired comparisons. A successful sham never rescues a rejected first reset. Missing/failed rows are not zero. No dropping unhelpful matches, seeds or paths.
aggregation: Summarize windows within each match, then four matches equally within seed; five-seed mean and sample SD describes initialization only. Also retain pooled row-level summaries and quantiles clearly labelled. No assumption that windows or seeds are independent matches; no performance-based pass threshold.

runtime.resume: Only whole saved model/seed/batch blocks after verified hashes; never restart live workers or mix changed math.
runtime.outputs: New study directory only; retain per-row/path metrics and compact states/support needed to audit them, code/source pins and execution receipts. Preserve all original source, code, checkpoints and results.

stopping: Freeze protocol and implementation/source hashes and pass synthetic/invariant checks before real forward. Stop on technical hash/no-op/locality/nonfinite failures, retain failure receipt and fix execution only with documented provenance. Complete the fixed matrix and report negative/zero/decaying responses without tuning. No new50 training, events, value-head fit, Shapley game, or claim of true causal/Goal benefit.
